model: 南華大學 大林校本部 無盡藏圖書館（既有完整L形模型）
scope: Additive limited whole-face materials only: 190 white central-cover/rib top triangles and 4+4 front-facing red roof-slope triangles. No new geometry, new building identity or full-material reconstruction.

personal_pixel_review.finding: White shallow cover and transverse rib top surfaces, upper front red slope and entrance red slope are distinct. Gray end frames, walls, recesses, entry glazing and adjacent roofs remain neutral. No visible color spill or cropping.
Only upward main-cover surfaces retain white; rear walls, rear service volumes, cover end/vertical faces and low wing are neutral, not misrepresented as evidenced colors.
Side elevation remains neutral except visible upper cover/rib surfaces; no extrapolation to side walls or side narrow roof slopes. Entire model remains in frame.
Frontal elevation shows the two limited red slopes; upper/entrance end caps and lintels remain neutral. Red banners and pink-brown mixed walls from photography are not painted onto the model.

White and two red front slope boundaries are finite and aligned with existing geometry. Side roofs, black-walkway location, back caps, gray end frames, glass pavilion and low wing roof are neutral. Conservative boundaries are material-evidence limits, not a claim all remaining surfaces are gray.

precise_surface_selection.white: All three vertices of each original triangle independently checked against one of five source cover_pts slope planes with finite x interval and y=-20..24, or one of the same five planes raised .28 at one of nine rib strips centered -19.5+43*i/8 with width .8. Upward geometric normal and correct plane-normal relation required. No centroid/bbox-only selection.
precise_surface_selection.red: All three vertices checked against each original hip front slope equation and trapezoid support: z and y bounds plus narrowing half-width at each vertex. Front-facing and upward normal required. End faces, back slopes and top planes excluded.
precise_surface_selection.selection_recomputed: Independently derived from the original generator numeric parameters, without importing builder or researcher classifier. Exact entire 4378-face map matches; 4180/190/8 counts. White top projected coverage exactly 1100 working square units confirms complete upward footprint rather than selected samples.

native_and_exchange_boundary: Original native audit supplied by builder records one mesh, one used Warm stone preview only material and 4378 faces; source gray PNG personally viewed and all 35 original bytes/SHA256/Git blobs independently verified. Final original STL to 3MF ordered triangles/vertices/material indices independently checked. Builder strict-lib3mf and actual material-edit/readback/Blender-edit reports read but not re-executed by reviewer.
source_dates_and_identity: Ground VR node1 has library identity/customnodeid W. datetime2023/9/18 is a system field, not verified camera EXIF; exact ground capture date not established.
Aerial node5 1970/1/1 is invalid default; true capture year unknown. White cover evidenced in that aerial, not asserted to have existed on a known 2023 date.
Sources need not be coeval, and no verified 2026 complete current condition is claimed.
This is the library at lower-left of the aerial, not central Chengjun, rear Xuehai, Yunshui, or a university gate.
limitations: RGB codes are uncalibrated visual proxies, not sampled engineering color specifications.
White vertical cover/rib side faces, side red roofs, rear roof details, main walls, mixed material recesses, glazing, banners and pavilions are outside authorized material scope and remain neutral.
No face splitting, new geometry, replacement triangulation, mesh repair, or changed dimensions: original4378 triangles/2159 indexed vertices retained exactly.
Original exterior approximation, OSM/estimated proportions, source-history and manufacturing limitations remain. No new physical print, slicer or multicolor-FFF guarantee.
3MF is a single colored surface mesh, not separate closed printable color bodies.
Independent rebuild comparison covered 3MF, map, palette and all five PNGs byte-for-byte. Blend binary determinism is not claimed; supplied semantic/edit/reopen QA used.
Source photographs and panorama tiles remain private research, not public package assets.
decision: No mandatory material-boundary, source-date, camera-framing or whole-face mapping correction found. PASS for this limited appearance only.
